Casey (sales): Medixia follow-up: POC targets steady 150 qps chat (~40 tokens) + short embedding spikes to 500 qps. They need recommended reserved GPU commit, burst behavior, and autoscale config. Also flagged KMS + 7y log retention in questionnaire.

Toni (solutions): 3-week POC, VPC peering acceptable. Spikes are brief (2-6m), 2-3x over baseline. Prefer quantized model where safe.

Matt (eng-runtime): Ballpark: 150*40 = 6k tokens/sec. Warm GPUs handle ~220-260 qps for short chats. Recommend baseline reserve=2 GPUs, allow bursts to 4.

Olivia (sre): Ops rec: autoscale min=2 max=4, cooldown=120s, kv_preheat=180s before expected spikes. Cross-AZ baseline placement to tolerate AZ loss.

Casey (sales): Billing for burst?

Matt (eng-runtime): Burst uses credit bucket; POC we can waive immediate charges. For commit: reserved covers baseline, burst billed at premium per-minute. Pricing to provide blended quote.

Evan (security): We support KMS + audit export to S3/BigQuery. 7y retention needs Legal sign-off; VPC peering OK for POC. I'll draft questionnaire answers.

Olivia (sre): Ops runbook bullets for handoff: 1) KV preheat 3m, 2) schedule-based prewarm if spikes predictable, 3) canary 5% traffic then ramp, 4) on AZ failover use burst to avoid 429s.

Matt (eng-runtime): Quick config snippet for quote: autoscale min=2 max=4 target_qps_per_gpu=180 cooldown=120 kv_preheat_seconds=180 burst_policy=allow_with_quota.

Toni (solutions): I'll confirm kickoff next Tue and attach the trace to ticket.

ops-bot: Created ticket POC-7821 assigned to Toni.

Casey (sales): Actions: Matt -> two-line hardware+autoscale for quote; Evan -> questionnaire draft; Olivia -> ops checklist; Toni -> confirm dates. Will update Medixia after items ready. :thumbsup:
